sourceProps.name: holdPages
sourceProps.description:
Hold each page on screen until the next one starts.

A subtitle cue is routinely longer than one page, so the pager splits it and
`getPageSequenceTiming` caps each page at `combineTokensWithinMilliseconds`.

and the start of the next — blank frames in the middle of somebody talking.
A subtitle file has no such holes, so the default closes them. Set `false`
to let a page clear when its own tokens run out.

items.question: Do I own the components?
items.answer: Yes. The CLI copies the source into your repo, so every component is yours to edit and ships with no runtime dependency on us.

items.question: Can I render on my own machine?
items.answer: Renders run wherever Remotion runs — your laptop, your CI, or a container you control.

items.question: What happens when a component updates?
items.answer: Re-run the add command and the CLI shows a diff before writing anything over your local edits.

items.question: Is there a licence for client work?
items.answer: MIT. Use it for client projects, products, or anything you ship.
